ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible ventral surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized to a narrow peripheral boundary along the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white field across both lobes; solid black continuous border along the trailing edge; small dark pixel clusters (mottling) observed at [x=left-tip, y=trailing-edge] and [x=right-tip, y=trailing-edge]; distinct dark vertical spot at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.5 relative to the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude along the primary trailing boundary; extreme high-amplitude jagged irregularities at both distal tips corresponding to external attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes; leading edges appear as straight vectors transitioning to acute curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered low-intensity grey circular spots on the interior white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, short vertical and diagonal dark pixel disruptions on the lower-left and mid-right white surface quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, high-relief irregular clusters (likely barnacle colonization) at the tips of both lobes; significant jagged indentation at the extreme right lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast 'drip' or 'comb' pattern where the black trailing edge pigmentation meets the white ventral surface.
